metadata.description: Define WHAT functions exist and HOW they interact (framework-agnostic)

purpose.primary: Analyze and document functional requirements as a DAG

workflows.name: Approach Detection
workflows.description: Auto-detect bottom-up vs top-down based on existing code

workflows.name: Functional Analysis
workflows.description: Core functional analysis workflow (FA-01 through FA-07)

exit_criteria.description: Requirements to leave P1 and enter P2
required_conditions: Dependencies form a valid DAG (no cycles)

functional_architecture.description: DAG of functions and their dependencies
functional_architecture.note: Framework-agnostic - always a DAG regardless of framework

flexible.description: Functional requirements can be refined during later phases

rigid.description: Functional requirements locked after P1 completion
rigid.on_discovering_new_function: Document as change request, do not add

on_entry: Read working_memory.json to get paths and mode
during_phase: Focus on WHAT functions exist, not WHERE they live
Ensure all functions have clear inputs/outputs
on_exit: Summarize: X functions, Y dependencies, Z entry points

quality_checks: All user requirements map to at least one function
No orphaned functions (unreachable from entry points)
All dependencies have valid source and target
